name: Knife says
source:
When you come to work like normal, and your kitchen knife started to talk to you,
what would you say?

<Knife says> is a shot visual novel telling a story that a knife talks to you about seemingly absurd topics. 

Make your own choices and see what's going to happen ---- next and in the end.

[From [url=https://magicqube.itch.io/o2a2-knife-says]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你像往常一样上班时，你的菜刀开始跟你说话，
你会说什么？

《刀说》是一部镜头视觉小说，讲述了一把刀与你谈论看似荒唐话题的故事。

做出你自己的选择，看看接下来会发生什么以及最终会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://magicqube.itch.io/o2a2-knife-says]Itch.io[/url]]
